subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Is the current evidence enough to authorize a code repair, or should maintainers require a live current-main Slack Socket Mode repro with redacted reaction envelopes first?
rationale: Source and shipped code prove handler support, but they do not identify why this live setup saw zero reaction envelopes after the earlier routing fix.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for a current-main multi-account Slack run with redacted raw Socket Mode payloads plus gateway trace logs before a repair PR is queued.

options.title: Fold into broader Socket Mode triage
options.body: Treat this as part of the broader Slack Socket Mode event-loss investigation only if maintainers can preserve the reaction-specific reproduction details there.

options.title: Queue speculative repair
options.body: Attempt a fix around filtering or liveness without live proof, accepting a higher chance of patching the wrong boundary.

recommendation.title: Require live repro first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask for a current-main multi-account Slack run with redacted raw Socket Mode payloads plus gateway trace logs before a repair PR is queued.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent authored the prior Slack system-event routing fix and is the strongest current-history owner for this path.
